transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net, Kim speaking.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. My broadband and TV have both been cut off. I paid the bill last week and I've got the receipt. I've got no TV, no internet, and two kids at home. I'm so stressed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you give me the address on the account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 14 Hill Street, Leicester, LE2 7PQ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Who's the account holder?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am. Wanjiru Kamau.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When did the service stop?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yesterday afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me place you on a brief hold while I look at the account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for holding. There's a block on the account for non-payment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: But I paid it, I've got the receipt.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Who did you say the account holder is?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Me. Wanjiru Kamau.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And it stopped when?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yesterday afternoon. I just told you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm not a miracle worker. That's the billing team's mess, not mine, ring them back tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow? I've got two kids with nothing here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me while I check something.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks for waiting. No, it'll have to be tomorrow. Billing opens at nine.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This is awful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Bye.
